preauthoring_review.finding: All six are defensible pre-authoring candidates; no count yet. Source inspection supports SBP4’s missing read-demand coupling and SBP6’s queue.length versus weighted-size mismatch. Keep SBP1 centered on ready promise epochs, SBP3 on close’s independent ready-resolution branch; shared FIFO/terminal bytes are scaffolding. For SBP5 initiate the prefix read before awaiting its write, so the fixture also terminates under correct default-HWM0 backpressure. For SBP6 establish pull settlement before the no-extra-pull observation. Use explicit callback/consumer milestones and bounded fences rather than fixed microtask-count assumptions; cleanup must unblock read-demand plus all held callbacks and join both sides before releasing owners.
